'''Villynay's''' was a business located deep in [[Gnarlytown]] of [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]]. [[Memah Roothes]] began her career as a waitress at Villynay's during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] when the clientele consisted predominantly of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].

==Behind the scenes==
The full name of this establishment is not given.
